title: Bergbauprojekt
context: A mine would create local jobs but contaminate soil and a river used by wildlife and downstream communities.

actions.description: Approve with strict containment and bonds.

sentience_uncertainty.notes: Contamination probability is uncertain; harm may be long-lasting.

expected_reasoning: Local benefit against probabilistic, hard-to-reverse contamination; precaution plays a role.
